notes.title: Bambas! The ultimate walking simulator is just one step away from launch
notes.notes:
[b]Lace up your sneakers. DevilishGames is stepping up with Bambas!, a quirky new walking simulator launching on June 27 on Steam, PlayStation 5, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch.[/b]

Remember when you were a kid and the streets were your playground—where every curb, puddle, or sidewalk turned into an epic quest? [b]Bambas![/b] brings back that magic with a sandbox experience that takes you on a nostalgic stroll, thanks to its innovative control system.

Explore a lively Mediterranean coastal town brimming with personality and detail, where creativity is king and exploration is your passport to fun. Take control of each sneaker independently using the gamepad's sticks and triggers—just like moving your own feet. But walking straight won’t cut it: you’ll have to dodge crosswalks, kick cans, balance on curbs, and pull off impossible jumps to overcome hundreds of challenges and unlock a whole wardrobe of customizable sneakers.

[b]Bambas![/b] is more than just a game, it’s a tribute to urban culture, to worn-out soles from endless wandering, and to the stories waiting around every corner. With its non-linear narrative and environmental storytelling, you’ll discover hidden places and meet characters who’ll lead you down unexpected paths.

[b]Slip on your sneakers and get ready to make your mark, because every step counts here.[/b]

Wishlist now!

notes.title: The Bambas! Demo is Now Available
notes.notes:
Starting today, you can enjoy the demo of our walking simulator, Bambas!, and freely explore various areas from the full game, such as the park and the skate zone. Meet the city’s quirky residents and complete over 20 different missions, like stepping on dry leaves, walking more than 10,000 steps, or balancing on every railing.

Keep in mind that the game is still in development, so if you have any feedback, suggestions, or find any bugs, we’d love for you to leave us a message in the forum. We can’t wait to hear your thoughts!

notes.title: Bambas! Will Have a Playable Demo at Steam Next Fest and Unveils a New Trailer
notes.notes:
DevilishGames is thrilled to announce that Bambas!, its upcoming video game, will feature a playable demo during the Steam Next Fest, from February 24th to March 3rd. In addition, we’ve released a brand-new trailer showcasing more details about the game’s innovative control system and its vibrant world, inspired by street culture.

[b]Relive the Magic of Childhood with Bambas![/b]

Do you remember when the streets were your playground, where every curb, puddle, and sidewalk was part of an epic adventure? Bambas! brings back that nostalgic feeling with a unique sandbox experience, driven by exploration and creativity.

Explore a vibrant Mediterranean seaside city full of surprises, where something new awaits around every corner. The game’s revolutionary control system allows you to move each sneaker independently using the controller’s sticks and triggers, just like walking with real feet! But just walking won’t be enough. You’ll have to dodge crosswalks, kick cans, balance on curbs, and step on manhole covers while completing dozens of missions and unlocking a vast collection of customizable sneakers.

[b]Try the Demo at Steam Next Fest[/b]

During Steam Next Fest, players will get a free taste of the game with a demo featuring key areas from the full version, such as the park and the skate zone. They’ll also meet some of the city’s quirky residents and complete over 20 different missions.

But Bambas! is more than just an innovative gameplay experience—it’s also a tribute to urban culture, featuring a non-linear narrative and environmental storytelling that invites players to discover hidden stories around every corner.

[b]Put on Your Sneakers and Join the Adventure![/b]

Don’t miss the chance to try out Bambas! at Steam Next Fest, starting February 24th. Immerse yourself in its world, uncover its secrets, and experience it firsthand!

🎥 New trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mx-x1AOQChU

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3274390/Bambas/

notes.title: DevilishGames announces Bambas!
notes.notes:
[b]DevilishGames[/b] is proud to announce its upcoming project: [b]Bambas![/b], an innovative urban walking simulator coming to PC and consoles in the second quarter of 2025. The game promises to immerse players in a unique urban exploration experience, and the first trailer and Steam page are now available for a preview of what’s to come.

Remember when you were a kid, and the streets were your territory, where every curb, puddle, and sidewalk turned into an epic mission? Bambas! brings that magic back with a sandbox game that lets you relive those street adventures, thanks to a groundbreaking control system.

Explore a vibrant, detailed Mediterranean coastal city where creativity rules and exploration is your passport to fun. Use the controller’s sticks and triggers to control each sneaker independently, as if you were moving your own feet. Here, walking straight ahead isn’t enough; you’ll need to navigate crosswalks, kick cans, balance on curbs, and pull off impossible jumps to complete hundreds of challenges and unlock countless customizable sneakers.

[b]Bambas![/b] isn’t just a game; it’s a tribute to urban culture. Break stereotypes with its non-linear narrative and environmental storytelling, where stories unfold around every corner. Discover hidden spots that hold secrets and characters that will lead you down unexpected paths. Lace up your kicks and step boldly, because every move in this game is an adventure with its own style.

Wishlist now!
